limitations: No human criterion acceptance, sprint closure or model qualification inferred.
Model inspection is advisory; literal citations do not establish semantic correctness.
Historical demo is not a reusable current approval; head/source/memory changes require a new capture.
Trusted fixed checks execute repository code; the runner is not an isolation sandbox.
summary: Typed QA contracts bind sources, diff, fixed checks, criterion matrix and advisory inspection to an exact Git revision. Nexo consumes evidence without accepting criteria or closing sprints.
title: Vera com evidência vinculada à revisão e parecer do Nexo
